picks.title: Sources: Cursor in talks to raise $2B+ at $50B valuation as enterprise growth surges
picks.why_it_matters: Cursor's meteoric rise from developer tool to $50B validates AI-native productivity software as a category and signals that enterprise GTM in dev tools can scale exceptionally fast—a thesis worth watching for adjacent opportunities.

picks.title: Loop raises $95M to build supply chain AI that predicts disruptions
picks.why_it_matters: A $95M Series C for supply chain AI shows continued investor appetite for vertical AI applications solving enterprise pain points, and Valor's involvement (major xAI backer) suggests smart money sees this as a durable category.

picks.title: Scoop: Anthropic to have peace talks at White House
picks.why_it_matters: Anthropic's direct engagement with the White House signals that AI regulatory frameworks are being shaped now at the highest levels—early-stage AI founders should anticipate compliance requirements emerging from these conversations.
